description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git pack index functionalities, including pack creation, indexing, verification, and handling of 64-bit offsets, corruption detection, and other pack-related operations.

methods.name: index_obj_nr
methods.description: Returns the object number within the pack index for a given SHA1 object ID.

methods.name: index_obj_offset
methods.description: Returns the offset of a specified object within the pack index.
